title: Two Years of Knocking Before the Labels Let Spotify Launch
conflicts: Label equity: Computer Sweden via The Register (Aug 2009) said the four majors held 18%, plus Merlin; TechCrunch's cap table the same day showed 17.3% for majors and Merlin together; the Guardian (2013) said around 20%; the LRB says almost a fifth. Story says 'close to a fifth'. Price paid disputed (Computer Sweden ~100,000 kronor vs TechCrunch sources saying about the VC price); story says only that it was disputed. Length of licence hunt: 18 months (Fortune, reporting Ek on Diary of a CEO) vs two years (Guardian); story avoids stating an exact length. Founding 2005 (Guardian) vs 2006 (Ek, Fortune); story uses 2006.
notes: Includes the documented detail that the early demo and invite-only beta used pirated tracks (Guardian, LRB). Ek's money/hair/weight quotes come via Fortune's report of the podcast. Quote stance: complicates.
